page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-44-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 44 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 22 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8481C processor running at 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 176 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance is equipped with 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 8 local SSDs, but does not include any GPU accelerators. The CPU features a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512, Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning acceleration, and hardware-assisted cryptography via AES and SHA-NI.

In benchmark evaluations, the c3-standard-44-lssd demonstrates balanced performance across compute, memory, and storage operations. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 15,429.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 47,611.69. Its cryptographic capabilities are notable, with a Passmark CPU encryption test score of 38,720.91, placing it in the top 25% of tested systems. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2,998.96 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 48.81 GB/sec. For database workloads, the instance sustained 47.3 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and scored 18,755.52 in Passmark database operations.

While the instance excels at medium-scale workloads, its performance varies under heavy computational demands. For example, LLM inference text generation using a small 135M model is strong at 265.38 tokens/sec, but drops to a poor 2.37 tokens/sec when processing a large 70B model, highlighting the limitations of running massive models without dedicated GPU acceleration. Given its high-speed local NVMe storage and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, the c3-standard-44-lssd is highly cost-efficient for resource-dense applications that require low-latency local storage. It is ideally suited for databases, web serving, software compilation, and moderate machine learning inference tasks.

It features 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 drives, with no GPU accelerators. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX. In benchmarks, the instance delivers balanced performance, highlighted by a Passmark CPU score of 47,611.69 and strong cryptographic performance in the top 25%. It handles Redis SET operations at 47.3 million operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 40.85 GB/sec. However, LLM inference on large 70B models is a bottleneck, yielding only 2.37 tokens/sec. This instance is highly suited for databases, software compilation, web serving, and moderate data processing workloads requiring fast local storage.
